{{Quote|Send them messages through Gadin Badolfa, the architect.|Candra Kitai, to her daughter, Orielle|<ref name="Sentinel" />}}
'''Gadin Badolfa''' was an [[Architect/Legends|architect]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] who worked for the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], the world's ruling body. While not a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], Badolfa nevertheless had powerful connections within the Lost Tribe's hierarchy, and his services were constantly in demand. In [[3960 BBY]], he aided [[Orielle Kitai]] and her [[Parent/Legends|mother]], [[Candra Kitai|Candra]], in their attempt to escape [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|How did it happen? Did Badolfa betray me?''"<br />"''Oh, we let Badolfa deliver your messages. Your mother made another deal.|Orielle Kitai and Sawj Luzo|<ref name="Sentinel" />}}
[[File:Orielle_Kitai.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Gadin Badolfa helped Orielle Kitai (pictured) with her attempt to escape her enslavement.]]
Gadin Badolfa was from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] and worked as an [[Architect/Legends|architect]] for the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]],<ref name="Sentinel" /> the world's reigning government.<ref name="Purgatory">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Purgatory]]''</ref> Despite being a non-[[Sith/Legends|Sith]], Badolfa was a respected individual and was often in high demand, earning the trust of several of the Tribe's [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lords]], including [[Candra Kitai]].<ref name="Sentinel" />

In [[3960 BBY]], following the [[Assassination attempt in the Korsinata|assassination attempt]] on [[Grand Lord]] [[Lillia Venn]]<ref name="Purgatory" /> and the [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]] of Kitai and her daughter [[Orielle Kitai|Orielle]] for suspected involvement in the attempt, Orielle contacted Badolfa at her [[Parent/Legends|mother's]] direction.<ref name="Sentinel" /> Orielle had recently discovered the location of an [[Aurek-class tactical strikefighter|''Aurek''-class tactical strikefighter]], the only [[Realspace/Legends|space]]-capable [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] on the planet,<ref name="Purgatory" /> and hoped to use the ship as [[Politics/Legends|political]] leverage to escape their enslavement and reinstate her and her mother's former positions in the Tribe. Badolfa met with Orielle, who asked him to send messages to four High [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lords]]&mdash;two each from the [[Red Faction|Red]] and [[Gold Faction|Gold]] political factions of the Tribe&mdash;inviting them to the [[Jelph Marrian's farm|farm]] of the [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Jelph Marrian]], where the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] was hidden. Badolfa assured Orielle that the High Lords could help her cause,<ref name="Sentinel" /> and he also revealed that Grand Lord Venn had elevated Orielle's rivals,<ref name="Purgatory" /> the [[Sith Saber]]s [[Flen Luzo|Flen]] and [[Sawj Luzo]], to the rank of [[Lord/Legends|Lord]]. Following the meeting, Badolfa delivered the messages, but Orielle was betrayed by her own mother, who told the Grand Lord of the starfighter.<ref name="Sentinel" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|He sees them all, and I still trust him.|Candra Kitai, regarding Badolfa and the Tribe's High Lords|<ref name="Sentinel" />}}
As a respected architect, Gadin Badolfa had many powerful connections to the upper echelons of the Lost Tribe and was highly placed in their society. A friend to the Kitais, he was willing to help Orielle and her mother in their struggle to escape slavery and warned Orielle when he learned that Grand Lord Venn had given Lordship to Orielle's rivals, the Luzos. Although Orielle initially believed that Badolfa had betrayed her when she [[Night of the Upside-Down Meteor|encountered]] the Grand Lord at Marrian's [[Farm/Legends|farm]], Badolfa had actually kept his promise and delivered the messages to the High Lords of the Tribe's Red and Gold factions.<ref name="Sentinel" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gadin Badolfa was mentioned in [[John Jackson Miller]]'s [[2011]] [[eBook]] ''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Sentinel]]'', the sixth installment in the [[Star Wars: Lost Tribe of the Sith|''Lost Tribe of the Sith'']] series.<ref name="Sentinel" />
